    # Uniform rows/columns form the panel separators.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    from collections import Counter
    line_colors = Counter([grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows] + [grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols])
    divider = line_colors.most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_edges = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_edges = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_spans = [(row_edges[i] + 1, row_edges[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_edges) - 1)]
    col_spans = [(col_edges[i] + 1, col_edges[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_edges) - 1)]
    # The most frequent non-divider color is the panel background.
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != divider)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [[background for _ in col_spans] for _ in row_spans]
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_spans):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_spans):
            panel = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
            for r in range(len(panel)):
                for c in range(len(panel[0])):
                    if panel[r][c] == background:
                        continue
                    if ((r + 1 < len(panel) and panel[r + 1][c] == panel[r][c]) or
                        (c + 1 < len(panel[0]) and panel[r][c + 1] == panel[r][c])):
                        out[ri][ci] = 1
                        break
                if out[ri][ci] == 1:
                    break
    return out
